scripts.build:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug && cd .. && copy android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk LIC-Smart-Assistant.apk
scripts.mobile:install: adb install -r LIC-Smart-Assistant.apk && adb shell monkey -p com.lic.app -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1
scripts.mobile:run: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
